scope:
Replay Harness hits and edits with original versus source-first early rejection.

Isolated compiler request with fixed prebuilt dependencies, not a Cargo/kache
speed comparison. Every pair starts from the same original-source entry set.
method: Same runtime, fixed paths and prebuilt dependencies; cloned source snapshot; real CLI help edit with preserved mtime; both environment-specific original-source keys primed; pristine original-source entries restored before each miss; reader memos and CAS blobs retained; nine alternating warm pairs and five alternating edited pairs; early rejection enabled for both modes; complete streams, artifact bytes/modes, codesign and direct CLI behavior checked.

original_staging_difference.scope: LC_UUID and exactly its CodeDirectory page hash; no byte rewriting

edited_staging_difference.scope: LC_UUID and exactly its CodeDirectory page hash; no byte rewriting

verification.limits: Nine warm and five source-edit pairs for an isolated diagnostic compiler request with fixed dependencies. Host sampling cannot prove quiet intervals; short hits may have no snapshots. No whole Cargo/kache speed claim or production adoption.

host_activity.limits: Snapshots cover only the monitor interval. Known build-tool names and ancestry are heuristic; zero observations do not prove an idle machine. ps CPU values are platform-specific snapshots, not integrated CPU time. No command arguments, environments, executable paths or unrelated process IDs are retained. No samples are removed and no process is stopped.

performance_qualification: Diagnostic only. External build activity overlaps eight of ten edited executions; short warm samples mostly fall between observations, with substantial other CPU activity in observed warm intervals. Preserve all samples. No whole-build, kache or adoption claim.
decision: Do not adopt or claim a speedup. Source prioritization lowers measured rejection work but offers no observed warm-hit gain and no clear total-request improvement. Investigate the repeated full-build warm deficit with a matched Nano/kache trace next.

initial_verification.limits: Initial correctness only; no actual Harness ordering activation, timing or adoption claim.

reproduction.limits: Patch chain reproduces runtime/build sources and executable fixture. Private snapshot has two unrelated benchmark-helper differences. Both runtime settings must be primed separately because the environment is part of the cache key.
